quarterly_data.quarter: Delta Electronics press release: Delta Unveils Microgrid Solutions and the Newly Launched (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Delta debuted its newly launched prefabricated solid-state transformer (SST)-based DC power system at Energy Taiwan 2026 (October 14-16), designed for AI factories and HPC data centers: a containerized SST integrated with DC/DC converters and control equipment that reduces power conversion stages; the Delta-developed SSTs have energy efficiency of up to 98.5%, and Delta says the system improves energy efficiency from grid to chip by up to 4-5% in AI data centers; the modular, prefabricated design shortens on-site deployment time by up to 50%; an optional high C-rate battery delivers millisecond-level power support for AI load fluctuations. VP and GM of the Energy Infrastructure Business Group Patrick Zhao: the system supports next-generation power architecture for the AI era.
quarterly_data.figure: SST efficiency up to 98.5%; grid-to-chip efficiency improvement up to 4-5%; on-site deployment time shortened by up to 50%

quarterly_data.quarter: Delta Electronics press release: Delta Unveils Microgrid Solutions and the Newly Launched (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Delta's solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) on-site power generation solution (for AI data centers, manufacturing facilities and critical infrastructure; can be integrated with the utility grid and energy storage) reaches an overall energy efficiency of up to 85% when combined with heat recovery. VP and GM of the Energy Infrastructure Business Group Patrick Zhao: Delta recently partnered with The Great Taipei Gas Corporation to develop Taiwan's first 550 kW SOFC demonstration site using locally manufactured equipment (a company claim).
quarterly_data.figure: SOFC overall energy efficiency up to 85%; 550 kW SOFC demonstration site
